purpose: The service synchronizes analytics data from a read replica to an S3 staging bucket for the analytics vendor to load into a warehouse.

components.name: analytics read replica (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: analytics read replica (PostgreSQL) is the read-only copy of the production database.

components.name: staging bucket (S3)
components.evidence: staging bucket (S3) receives the extract files.

components.name: Analytics vendor
components.evidence: Analytics vendor picks the files up from the staging bucket for the warehouse.

flows.evidence: sync-job reads the list of tables from its configuration.
sync-job writes them into files of at most one million rows and uploads the files into the folder of the day.
Analytics vendor picks the files up from the staging bucket for the warehouse.
